about: scripts/budget/{light,heavy}.sh: the host's wrappers of `ergo budget`. Each mutant restores a way the run's own copies went wrong, and a test of this package kills it.

mutants.name: budget-light-crit-from-env
mutants.rule: A light run is crit only when its workspace is in the crit file.

mutants.name: budget-scratch-no-sweep
mutants.origin: wf10 TMPDIR-PER-RUN (2026-11-20: killed runs left tens of GiB under /tmp)
mutants.rule: A run's start removes every scratch folder whose lock no run holds: a killed run's.

mutants.name: budget-heavy-crit-from-env
mutants.rule: A heavy run is crit only when its workspace is in the crit file.

mutants.name: budget-heavy-width-uncapped
mutants.rule: A heavy run's width is at most the budget's cores, so a run wider than the budget still runs.

mutants.name: budget-heavy-p-ignored
mutants.rule: A heavy go test takes its -p as its width.
